name: Sion Airport

runway.v: Runway 07/25, 2,000 m × 40 m, asphalt (plus a 660 m grass strip, VFR only)

hours.v: Oct–Mar: 07:00 UTC (08:00 local) to day/night limit, at the latest 19:00 UTC (20:00 local). Apr–Sep: 05:00 UTC (07:00 local) to day/night limit, at the latest 18:00 UTC (20:00 local).

curfew.v: Closed outside opening hours; special permission needed. With PPR: winter 06:00–07:00 UTC (07:00–08:00 local, PPR by 16:00 UTC the day before) and day/night limit to 20:00 UTC (to 21:00 local, PPR by 11:00 UTC); summer 18:00–19:00 UTC (20:00–21:00 local, PPR by 10:00 UTC). Nothing 21:00–07:00 local without special permission.
curfew.quote: Special permission is required for flights outside of the opening hours.

ppr.v: PPR for the edge hours (see curfew)
ppr.quote: OCT-MAR: 0600 - 0700, PPR until 1600 the preceding day,

customs.v: Customs and immigration during aerodrome opening hours only

handling.v: Handling agent mandatory for non-based aircraft over 3 t; no self-handling
handling.quote: For non-based aircraft with MTOM > 3 tons, a handling agent is mandatory. Self-handling is not allowed.

noise.v: Mon–Sat 06:00–07:00, 11:00–12:00 and 17:00–19:00 local (winter; 05:00–06:00, 10:00–11:00, 16:00–18:00 UTC in summer) plus Sundays and holidays: several operations are banned, including noise category A and B and multi-engine aircraft (see AD 2.20). APU at most 15 min before departure and 10 min after arrival.
noise.quote: a MAX of 15 MIN prior to ACFT DEP

notes: Read AIP Switzerland AD 2 LSGS, AMDT 006/2024 effective 13 Jun 2024, as hosted on the Sion airport site: an older edition, not the AIRAC in force; the current Swiss AIP (skybriefing) was not opened. Customs hours above are the winter opening hours (latest 20:00 local, earlier at sunset). The AD 2.20 noise windows need checking against the current AIP: the pilot-info page and AIP text differ in wording.
